description: This file defines the base activity class for Android applications, providing logging setup and lifecycle management, serving as a foundation for other activity classes.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class extending FragmentActivity that initializes logging and handles activity lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles activity creation; currently just calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity becomes visible; sets up logging by calling initializeLogging().

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain by creating a LogWrapper and attaching it to the Log class, then logs a 'Ready' message.
